name: Lord Howe Island Group
description: Lord Howe Island is a crescent of volcanic rock in the Tasman Sea, about 600 km east of Port Macquarie, Australia. Forested hills rise to 875 m at Mount Gower, and a sheltered coral lagoon runs along the west coast. The group's 28 islands and islets, including the spire of Ball's Pyramid, shelter many endemic species, especially birds.
